prompt:
Hand-painted stylised texture for a bright, high-fantasy voxel game. Painterly: soft brush shapes, chunky readable forms, detail gathered in clumps, never photographic and never noisy. One light from the top left: each shape has a highlight on its top-left edge and shade on its bottom-right edge. Shadows lean cool blue-purple, highlights lean warm; colours are rich and saturated. Seen flat and straight on, orthographic, no perspective, evenly lit across the whole frame, no vignette. The material fills the frame edge to edge as a seamless tileable texture. This image is one face of one block in the game, seen from a few steps away, so the forms are bold and readable, never busy. No border, no text, no logo, no objects other than the material. An original look, not copied from any existing game.

The material: lush rich green lawn grass seen from directly above, like a dense meadow. Thousands of fine grass blades in soft, irregular, flowing tufts that merge into each other, lit on their top left, darker hollows in between, bright yellow-green blade tips catching the light. The tufts are broad and loose, about four or five across the image, never round balls, mounds, moss or bushes. Even coverage, no flowers, no bare soil, no regular pattern.
